svg.title: Badger sculpture: UV before and after unwrap
svg.desc: Actual TEXCOORD_0 triangle edges read from the remeshed and UV-unwrapped 5212-triangle GLB files. A layout diagram, not a distortion or overlap test.

g.text: ONE SCULPT / 5,212 TRIANGLES / TWO UV LAYOUTS
Measured from saved GLB data. Same triangle count does not mean the old textures remain registered.

svg.text: UV plotted with v increasing downward. Seams can split vertices. Diagram is display-only; source models are not included.
